name: DoinGud marketplace acceptOffer zero-amount replay
summary: The DoinGud marketplace facet's acceptOffer(offerer, tokenId, price, amount) pays the full offer price out of the diamond's USDC escrow even when amount is 0, transferring no NFT and leaving the offer record in place, and it does not stop the offerer from accepting its own offer. The attacker funded one self-offer with flash-swapped USDC and accepted it twice with amount 0, receiving the price twice and draining other users' escrowed USDC.

loss.notes: Gross depletion of the diamond's pre-existing USDC.e escrow (third-party deposits accumulated from 2021 to 2023): the balance falls from 35486.935717 at block 94170780 to 0 after the exploit. The attacker's own flash-swapped deposit of the same amount (log 3) is returned by the first accept (log 6) and is not loss. The attacker's net 35380.154566 USDC.e is lower by the 106.781151 USDC.e flash-swap fee paid to the pair, which does not reduce victim depletion.

ageReset.description: DiamondCut on the DoinGud diamond Replaced selectors 0x5c924960 (acceptOffer), 0x2fdced43, 0x7e30474a, 0xf6dbe82d (makeOffer) and 0x696bd1d3 with marketplace facet 0x123aafc8d0a07ce1a146e53aa899e77f21a2dde1 (data word 11) and Added 0x49c5fc38 to it. It is the last of 18 DiamondCut events that routes acceptOffer or makeOffer; facetAddress(0x5c924960) and facetAddress(0xf6dbe82d) still return the facet at block 94170780.

sources.note: Anchor, root cause, first exercise, identity and age. Source-1: status 1, block 94170781 index 0, ts 1789961245, EOA 0xb8c717239bcace558c3a8dc471c16e07bf57a1eb calls its helper 0xe588834aa3161a0720e8f6bf223748d6098a4b76. Receipt: log 1 pair 0x160532d2536175d65c03b97b0630a9802c274dad flash-sends 35486.935717 USDC.e to the helper; log 3 helper -> diamond 35486935717 (makeOffer 0xf6dbe82d, offer event 0x4fd4d168 log 5); then two byte-identical acceptOffer 0x5c924960(helper, tokenId 1, price 35486935717, amount 0) calls: each emits diamond->helper Transfer of 35486935717 (logs 6 and 10), ERC-1155 TransferSingle 0xc3d58168 helper->helper id 1 value 0 (logs 7 and 11) and accept event 0x923ba701 (logs 9 and 13). The same offer pays twice for zero NFT delivered; the marketplace facet is unverified (Polygonscan getsourcecode empty), so the defect is established from this receipt and the PoC's fork tests (source-2: amount 0 replays, amount 1 reverts). Earliest exercise: Etherscan V2 logs.getLogs on the diamond for topic 0x923ba7017c46c4e3150f1ea286e0881f0a3ab97f16f6944a1a7a9b371446f234, blocks 0..99999999, returns 6 events: 4 earlier (blocks 30094840, 30255775, 30289386, 30384173) each with TransferSingle value 1 and payment <= 0.3 USDC.e (legitimate; the self-accept 0xca7ef3b10b0724fc3054bfda49668493de671318199d6e9a3c03ec2e720269a5 has price 0), then the two source-1 accepts. Identity: debug_traceTransaction shows the diamond DELEGATECALLing 0x123aafc8d0a07ce1a146e53aa899e77f21a2dde1; facetAddress(bytes4) for 0x5c924960 and 0xf6dbe82d at block 94170780 returns it. Facet created top-level by 0x10101098c00dd94898f40c81ba36e2334b5fae1a in source-8 (block 24978993 index 27); eth_getCode empty at 24978992; keccak runtime 0x9c652c1a...74d4 (6994 bytes) at 24978993, 24978997 and 94170780. Diamond 0xe3a161edd679fc5ce2db2316a4b6f7ab33a8ed6a (DoinGudDiamond, verified) created top-level by the same deployer in source-7 (block 21949570 index 38); runtime 0x0453a86a...7a2a unchanged at 94170780. Age: Etherscan getLogs DiamondCut topic 0x8faa7087... on the diamond, blocks 0..99999999, returns 18 events (last at block 25893259); decoding all, only log 127 of source-4 (block 24978997 index 37, ts 1644947300) routes 0x5c924960/0xf6dbe82d, a Replace to the facet whose address is data word 11 (data word 6 is the Add of 0x49c5fc38 to the same facet). No later cut touches these selectors, so the facet activation at that cut is the age basis: 1789961245 - 1644947300 = 145013945 s (4.6 years). No configuration value is necessary to the missing zero-amount/cleanup check.

Loss. eth_call USDC.e 0x2791bca1f2de4661ed88a30c99a7a9449aa84174 balanceOf(diamond) = 35486935717 at block 94170780 and 0 at 94170781. Etherscan V2 account.tokentx for the diamond and USDC.e, sort=desc: the last pre-exploit movement is 0x94647c0cbc9e... at block 46544299; the preceding inflows are third-party deposits back to 2021, none from the attacker addresses. Source-1 USDC.e flows touching the diamond: +35486935717 from helper (log 3), -35486935717 (log 6), -35486935717 (log 10): net diamond depletion 35486935717 (6 decimals) = 35486.935717 USDC.e. Helper repays the pair 35593716868 (log 15) and forwards 35380154566 to the EOA (log 18). No later successful accept event exists; the escrow is empty after the exploit, so the campaign is this single transaction.
